description: Tracked source for ~/.codex/hooks.json. Install with: cp .codex/user-hooks.json ~/.codex/hooks.json — see CLAUDE.md. User-level on purpose: Codex loads a project's own .codex/ hooks ONLY in a trusted project, and every Codex session runs in a fresh managed worktree whose path was never trusted, so the repo-scoped copy beside this file is inert exactly where Codex sessions run. This no-ops in any repo that does not ship .claude/owner-only-skills.sh, so it is safe to have on for every project.
